name: The Cellar King

mechanics.description: Summons 2 cellar rats at low health. The player must switch targets or clear the adds before they overwhelm.
Chews ledger piles to heal slightly unless interrupted. The player must stop the heal with a melee attack or a thrown object.
Drops a cellar_king_whisker trophy on defeat.

failureState: The player can retreat to the Sootcellar at any time. No death penalty. Lost food is the only cost.
whatItTeaches: How to eat food, how to switch targets, and how to interrupt a heal.
whatItDoesNotReplace: Normal combat training at the Sootcellar or the Warden Steps. The Cellar King is a named encounter, not a replacement for fighting rats.

name: Mudhook Grib

mechanics.description: Periodically raises a scrap shield. The shield blocks all melee damage from the front. Javelins and mauls break the shield faster.
Throws mud to slow movement. The player must move to a safe tile or eat food to recover speed.
Drops a mudhook_jaw trophy on defeat.

lair.area: North Quarry Road, near the Tinstone Cut entrance

failureState: The player can retreat to the North Quarry Road. Death is possible but rare. Lost food is the primary cost.
whatItTeaches: How to switch weapons against armour, how to break shields, and how to manage movement debuffs.
whatItDoesNotReplace: Normal mining or smithing at the Foundry Row. Mudhook Grib is a combat encounter, not a gathering target.

name: Ashling in the Kiln

mechanics.description: Heat bursts on floor tiles. The drake flares the kiln, creating hot tiles that deal damage over time.
Smoke vents reduce line of sight. The player must move to safe tiles to avoid heat damage.
Tide spells and Tide beads reduce heat stacks. The player can use Tide magic to cool the kiln.
Drops an ashling_ember trophy on defeat.

lair.area: The Old Kiln, near the Sootcellar and Foundry Row

failureState: The player can retreat to the Foundry Row. Death is possible if the player stands on heat tiles too long. Lost food is the primary cost.
whatItTeaches: How to manage heat, how to use Tide beads, and how to switch between ranged and melee.
whatItDoesNotReplace: The Old Kiln Watch activity. The skilling boss is a combat encounter. The activity is a skilling loop.

name: The Bell Bat Mother

mechanics.description: Alternates between roost and swoop. When roosting, the bat is weak to ranged and magic. When swooping, it is weak to melee.
Summons bell bats during the roost phase. The player must clear the adds or they will overwhelm.
Sound pulse interrupts slow weapons. The bat screeches, interrupting slow melee attacks and long spell casts.
Drops a bat_mother_claw trophy on defeat.

lair.area: Bellwood Copse, in the Lath Yard rafters

failureState: The player can retreat to the Bellwood Copse. No death penalty. Lost food is the only cost.
whatItTeaches: How to switch combat styles, how to manage adds, and how to avoid interrupts.
whatItDoesNotReplace: Normal bowcraft or magic training. The Bell Bat Mother is a combat encounter, not a skilling target.

name: Old Snapper

mechanics.description: Can be lured with bait. The player can throw bait to draw the snapper to a specific tile.
Surfaces on predictable water tiles. The player can predict where it will surface.
Drops a snapped_hook trophy on defeat.

lair.area: River Stoop / Wardenbrook, in the water near the ferry dock

failureState: The player can retreat to the River Stoop. No death penalty. Lost bait and food are the primary costs.
whatItTeaches: How to use bait, how to position for combat, and how to choose a combat style.
whatItDoesNotReplace: Normal fishing or cooking at the River Stoop. The snapper is a combat encounter, not a gathering target.

name: The Wrong Flower

mechanics.description: Rot aura if candles go out. The flower emits a rot aura that deals damage over time unless the player has lit shrine candles.
Grave mites spawn from bad soil. The flower's footsteps leave bad soil that spawns mites.
Fire damage helps but can enrage if careless. Too much fire makes the flower aggressive, increasing its attack speed.
Drops a polite_root trophy on defeat.

failureState: The player can retreat to the Lowgrave Chapel. Death is possible if the rot aura is too strong. Lost candles and food are the primary costs.
whatItTeaches: How to use Favour in combat, how to manage candles, and how to cleanse rot.
whatItDoesNotReplace: Normal Favour training at the Shrine Hearth or Lowgrave Chapel. The Wrong Flower is a combat encounter, not a skilling target.
